tools.name: firecrawl_scrape
tools.description: Convert a single web page into clean, LLM-ready markdown via Firecrawl (handles JS-rendered pages and complex layouts that plain web_fetch extracts poorly). Complements web_fetch — for a quick simple-page read use web_fetch; use this when you need high-fidelity clean-markdown extraction. Firecrawl is a DIRECT api.firecrawl.dev integration (API key via daemon config toolApis.firecrawlKey or CUE_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY) — NOT Composio/OAuth. If the key is missing this tool returns a clear message; relay it and NEVER offer a Composio 'Connect Firecrawl' flow.

url.description: The page URL to scrape. If scheme is missing, https:// is assumed.

only_main_content.description: Optional (default true). Strip headers, navigation, and footers, returning only the main content.

max_chars.description: Optional. Maximum characters of markdown to return (default 20000, max 100000).

tools.name: firecrawl_crawl
tools.description: Bounded multi-page site crawl via Firecrawl: starts at a URL, follows child links, and returns each crawled page as clean markdown. Use ONLY when the user needs content from multiple pages of one site (docs site, blog, site section) — for a single page use firecrawl_scrape or web_fetch. Bounds are HARD-CAPPED in the executor: max_pages is clamped to 20 and max_depth to 2 regardless of what you pass. Firecrawl is a DIRECT api.firecrawl.dev integration (API key via daemon config toolApis.firecrawlKey or CUE_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY) — NOT Composio/OAuth. If the key is missing this tool returns a clear message; relay it and NEVER offer a Composio connect flow.

url.description: The starting URL for the crawl (child pages under it are followed).

max_pages.description: Optional. Maximum pages to crawl (default 10; hard cap 20 — larger values are clamped).

max_depth.description: Optional. Maximum link depth from the start URL (default 1; hard cap 2 — larger values are clamped).

wait_seconds.description: Optional. Maximum seconds to wait for the crawl job to finish (default 180, max 600).
